subject: Cetus · 22 May 2025
klass: An overflow check that checked the wrong bits
dek: A shift left by 64 needed its input under 2¹⁹², but the guard compared against a bound 2⁶⁴ times too generous. The top bits vanished, and billions of units of liquidity cost one token.

subject: Balancer v2 · 3 Nov 2025

subject: Constantinople / EIP-1283 · Jan 2019

dek: transfer() was reentrancy-safe because a storage write cost 5000 gas and it forwards 2300. One EIP cut the price to 200.
